measurement_basis_note: Varargs remain attempted. Functions whose only static holes are unsupported exception-representation fallbacks are also sampled; cases reaching a hole remain inconclusive. Static hole counts are unchanged. Coverage and rates differ from the earlier hole-free-only sampling population. Synthesized native calls now use main-thread signal deadlines, including random free-function calls; timed-out calls are skipped, never recorded as source exceptions. Python's normal recursion limit is preserved. These bounds may change the sample relative to python-exception-guards-v3. Recovered class metadata selects exact source-file and class-path identities for native object snapshots. Unresolved identities, local-class captures, bound callable state and container subclass state are refused and counted. This changes the sampled population relative to python-deadlines-v4. Class-valued outcomes compare exact qualified identities. Traced outcomes distinguish an executed return instruction from exception unwinding, including returns of None after handled exceptions. Ambiguous unwind types and suspended generator/coroutine frames are counted as trace gaps, not fabricated call outcomes. Heap graphs preserve mutable list/dict/object identity, cycles, detached input objects and fresh reachable objects. Scalar tags and float bits, object fields and ordered dictionary payloads are compared. Globals outside those roots, immutable-value identity, instance-dictionary insertion order and internal mutation versions are outside this claim.
skipped_note: call-event counts, not function counts: a function whose case quota is already full still logs skips for every further call. Bound coverage with `coverage`, never with these.
